title: Lamb Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish featuring tender lamb in a rich and nutty curry sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in curry powder and garam masala; cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Return lamb to pot and stir in coconut milk.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until lamb is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
